title: SAML IdP behavioral profile and integration checklist (Okta/Azure/Google/Ping) — RBAC v2 & audit mapping
creator: Aisha Karim
description: Goal: produce an IdP-specific behavioral profile and integration checklist that ensures our SAML onboarding reliably wires into RBAC v2, emits consistent audit events for forensic traversal, and exposes the expected admin controls in Console. Scope covers Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace (SAML), and PingFederate. Deliverables: 1) IdP behavior matrix + canonical mapping table from SAML attributes/groups to RBAC v2 primitives (roles, admin flags, org-scoped permissions); 2) audit log schema additions and example events; 3) conformance test harness (integration tests that run in CI using test IdP sandboxes or recorded SAML assertions); 4) Console admin setup docs (step-by-step for each IdP) and an internal runbook for SEs/Support. Out of scope: SCIM full provisioning flow (separate ticket), OIDC flows (separate ticket), on-prem Ping federate advanced connector customization.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical mapping table for Okta/Azure/Google/Ping implemented and reviewed
Audit log schema extended to include IdP issuer, NameID, AssertionID, mapping decisions and fallback reason fields
Conformance test harness with per-IdP tests added to CI and passing on main branch
Console docs published (public) and internal runbook created with troubleshooting steps and known IdP quirks
Feature flag + rollout plan exists to enable RBAC v2 SAML mapping for 10% of orgs and a staged canary for 50% then 100%
test_plan: Positive: Okta sends 'redwood_roles' attribute -> map to RBAC v2 roles; verify tokens and audit event contains mappedRoles
Fallback: Okta sends group list only -> verify group-to-role fallback mapping and that fallbackReason is logged
Azure AD: test incoming 'roles' and 'groups' claims, verify prioritized attribute selection (roles > groups) and admin flag derivation
Google Workspace: test both attribute-as-list and attribute-as-comma-string encodings; assert parsing tolerance
Ping: validate nested attribute cases and URL-encoded SAML attributes; assert our parser extracts expected values
Negative: malformed assertion (missing Issuer) -> ensure SAML handshake rejected and audit event recorded with failureReason
End-to-end: new user SSO join + RBAC assignment + first API call -> confirm audit trail shows identity_asserted, mapping_applied, and role_granted events
updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Security, Backend, and DX. Agreed scope and deliverables. Action: create canonical mapping doc.
2025-02-15: Initial mapping draft completed (github link below). Decision: prefer explicit SAML attribute 'redwood_roles' when present; fall back to group mapping rules documented.

2025-02-18: Trade-off discussion: store raw SAML Assertion in audit logs for forensics vs PII exposure. Decision: store assertion metadata (Issuer, AssertionID, NameID, attributes hash) and keep full assertion in encrypted long-term archive accessible only to Security on request.
2025-02-20: Implemented parser adjustments for Google comma-encoded attributes. Test harness updated with a sample assertion for Google Workspace (recorded cassette).
2025-02-24: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4567 (adds mapping table and parser). Requested review from @marcel and @sumaya.
2025-02-26: Review feedback from DX: need clearer Console copy for admin controls and extra screenshots per IdP. @Nina assigned to produce screenshots.

2025-02-27: CI tests failing for Ping nested attribute case. Root cause: our XML parser dropped namespaces on some assertions. Mitigated by switching to strict-namespace parser. Serena to validate with Ping test sandbox.
2025-03-02: Security review requested (ticket linked). Also added rollout strategy notes and canary gating to release plan. Next: finalize docs and merge PRs after review fixes.
notes: Key implementation choices: 1) attribute priority: explicit role attribute -> 'roles' claim -> groups -> email-domain fallback; 2) audit logging: create events mapping_applied and mapping_fallback with reason codes (EXPLICIT, GROUP_MATCH, DOMAIN_FALLBACK, PARSE_ERROR); 3) admin controls: add 'force_mfa' and 'sso_only' toggles at org-level in Console tied to IdP configuration. Blockers: Ping sandbox credentials (request with Partner Eng), final legal review on audit retention policy.
